_about: Every market/cost assumption used by sim/engine.py. Each block has a `_source` map: key -> where the number comes from (panel, competitor page, public benchmark, or 'estimate'). Numbers marked 'estimate' are placeholders for the CEO to recalibrate from founder/panel and the competitor map. Money in EUR; rates are per week unless the key says _monthly / per_month.

_source.search_strategies: SPEC suggests 300 x 150 then top 10 x 1,000; raised to 800 x 200 (5 generations) and top 10 x 2,000 fresh seeds because a full run still takes ~6-10 min on 2 vCPU
_source.seeds_sensitivity: 600 seeds gives ~+/-2pp standard error on a 50% survival rate (common random numbers make +/- comparisons tighter)
_source.quick: smoke-test sizes; results are noisy and only for checking the pipeline

_source.starting_cash: idea.md (ASSUMED by CEO): about 5,000 EUR bootstrapped
_source.m3_week: SPEC: month 3 = end of week 13 after launch
_source.m3_min_cum_revenue: SPEC viability.m3_min_cum_revenue (cash-basis gross billings incl. annual prepay and LTD payouts)
_source.max_build_weeks: estimate: two unpaid founders do not keep building for more than ~7 months without launching; beyond this the run counts as build_too_long

_source.admin_overhead_share: estimate: finance/admin/legal/email takes ~8% of founder time
_source.hour_value_eur: estimate: only used to express hour-based CAC in EUR in reports, never paid

_source.tools_per_month: estimate: AI coding tools (2 seats ~40), email/domain/analytics/error tracking ~70
_source.hosting_base_per_month: estimate: small VPS/serverless + DB + CDN for widget script
_source.hosting_per_customer_per_month: estimate: storage, logs, widget bandwidth per active site
_source.accounting_admin_per_month: estimate: French SASU online accountant + bank fees, low tier
_source.stripe_pct: SPEC/public benchmark: Stripe ~2.9% + 0.25 blended (EU cards are cheaper, non-EU and Billing add-on are dearer)
_source.app_store_rev_share: public benchmark: Shopify App Store 0% on the first USD 1M lifetime (15% above); WordPress.org takes nothing. Billing via platform replaces Stripe fees
_source.llm_cost_per_conv: estimate (triangular min/mode/max per run): 3-8 turns with RAG context on a mid-tier LLM API, 0.005-0.03 EUR per conversation
_source.llm_action_multiplier: estimate: on-site actions need DOM snapshots + tool calls, ~40% more tokens when actions are enabled
_source.llm_price_decline_per_year: estimate: per-token API prices have fallen 20-50%/yr; conservative 25%

_source.base_build_weeks: estimate: one platform + one action MVP (widget, dashboard, mascot generator, billing) with AI coding tools, 2 founders full-time
_source.per_extra_platform: estimate: each extra platform (Shopify app, WP plugin, Webflow/Wix, JS SDK) adds ~35% to build
_source.per_extra_action: estimate: each extra on-site action type adds ~12%
_source.pro_style_factor: estimate: a second 'pro/sober' art direction for the animation set
_source.build_overrun_sigma: estimate: lognormal schedule overrun (median 1.0, p90 ~1.5x) - software estimates slip
_source.asr_narrow_start: estimate (board Product lens: nobody has numbers): success rate of on-site actions on never-seen sites at launch, narrow scope
_source.asr_breadth_penalty: estimate: each extra platform/2 actions lowers launch success rate by 5pp
_source.asr_hours_scale: estimate: engineering hours to close ~63% of the gap to asr_max (scaled up by breadth)
_source.maintenance_hours_base: estimate: weekly hours just to keep the product running (bugs, LLM API changes)
_source.incident_prob_per_week: estimate: chance per week of a visible incident (widget breaks a site, bad answer screenshot), x(1+0.5*breadth), x3 if maintenance under-staffed
_source.incident_churn_mult: estimate: churn multiplier during a month with an incident
_source.feature_hours_scale: estimate: hours to ship ~63% of the 'obvious next features' (analytics, integrations)
_source.setup_friction_per_10min: estimate: each 10 minutes of setup before the first useful answer costs ~3% of trial conversions
_source.unsupported_platform_fit: estimate: a segment whose platform is not supported can still paste a script tag but gets chat-only, fit x0.35
_source.action_fail_conv_penalty: estimate: conversion multiplier = 1 - need_actions*(1-asr)*penalty (board Product lens risk #1)

_source.hours_per_page: estimate: AI-assisted article/comparison page incl. research and editing
_source.visits_per_page_mature: public benchmark style: long-tail pages on a young domain average 10-30 visits/month once ranking
_source.page_exponent: estimate: diminishing returns (easy keywords first, cannibalisation)
_source.page_ramp_weeks: estimate: indexing + ranking climb for a page after the sandbox
_source.sandbox_weeks: SPEC: Google sandbox ~8-16 weeks before meaningful traffic for a new domain (uniform per run)
_source.sandbox_floor: estimate: share of mature traffic during the sandbox (brand + ultra-long-tail)
_source.backlinks_per_page: estimate: natural links earned per page published
_source.authority_ref_backlinks: estimate: referring domains for authority multiplier ~1
_source.authority_cap: estimate: a 1-year-old domain does not out-rank established players
_source.demand_ref_share: traffic potential x (sum of targeted segments search_share (SEO) / ai_share (GEO) / ref)^exponent: a niche with half the search demand of an average segment gets ~70% of its traffic
_source.focus_seo_bonus: SPEC: one-segment focus gives an SEO bonus (topical authority)
_source.yield_sigma: estimate: per-run lognormal uncertainty on SEO yield

_source.mentions_per_hour: estimate: directory listings, Reddit/IH answers, review requests per hour
_source.index_lag_weeks: estimate: AI assistants/AI Overviews pick up new sources with a lag of weeks
_source.citation_p_max: estimate: even a well-known niche tool is cited in at most ~half of relevant AI answers
_source.max_referrals_per_week: estimate (deliberately conservative, very uncertain): AI-referral visitors/week for an average segment at citation p=1, scaled by the targeted segments' ai_share; AI referral traffic is small but high-intent
_source.signup_mult: public benchmark style: AI-referred visitors convert ~1.5-2x organic
public benchmark style: paid search visitors for a new brand convert below organic

_source.weekly_prob: estimate: ~1 in 80 weeks a post/thread/newsletter mention takes off (fat upper tail); counted as launch traffic
_source.visitors_median: estimate: lognormal spike size, p90 ~9k visitors
_source.signup_mult: estimate: viral visitors are curious, low intent

_source.network_launch_visitors: estimate: founders' own X/LinkedIn/IH/newsletter audience on launch week (uniform per run; spread like a launch)
_source.visitors_per_customer_per_week: estimate: word of mouth / 'what is that mascot?' clicks per paying customer site
_source.signup_mult: estimate: referred visitors convert better than cold search

_source.focus_conv_bonus: SPEC: one-segment focus gets a conversion/positioning bonus (+20% estimate)
_source.dilution_per_extra_segment: SPEC: many segments dilute positioning (estimate -5% per extra segment)
_source.non_target_conv_mult: estimate: visitors from a segment the site is not written for convert at 60%
_source.non_target_traffic_share: estimate: share of SEO/GEO traffic that still comes from non-target segments
_source.launches: estimate: Product Hunt top-5 day 1-3k visitors, a typical launch 200-400; Show HN front page 2-5k, usually it sinks; directories trickle + backlinks
_source.launch_week_split: estimate: launch traffic decays over 3 weeks
_source.badge_visitors_per_active_free_user: estimate: 'Powered by Mascott' badge clicks per active free site per week

_source.presell_fit_mult: estimate: paying for a pilot before trying converts at ~60% of a trial (board Offers lens: presell 5-10 pilots)
_source.presell_discount: estimate: pilot price -20% for paying 3 months upfront
_source.presell_prepay_weeks: estimate: pilots prepay 3 months (cannot churn during the pilot)
_source.contacts_per_hour: estimate: personalised cold email/LinkedIn DM with a short Loom or screenshot, ~8 min each
_source.positive_reply_share: public benchmark style: ~30-40% of replies are interested (rest: no/unsubscribe/later)
_source.demo_hours: estimate: demo call + follow-up per interested reply
_source.trial_quality_mult: estimate: founder-led demo trials convert ~1.3x self-serve
_source.focus_reply_bonus: estimate: one-segment copy is more relevant, +20% replies
_source.waitlist_to_trial: estimate: share of pre-launch interested replies that actually start a trial at launch

_source.listing_hours: estimate: listing, screenshots, compliance (Shopify review checklist, WP plugin guidelines)
_source.review_weeks: public benchmark style: Shopify app review takes ~1-6 weeks incl. resubmissions
_source.base_installs_per_week: estimate: a new, unreviewed app in a crowded 'chat/AI assistant' category; rank grows with reviews
_source.store_segments: which segments install from each store (WordPress directory: WooCommerce shops, showcase sites, agencies) - estimate
_source.install_to_trial: estimate: share of installs that complete onboarding into a real trial

_source.partner_signup_rate: estimate: share of contacted agencies that become active resellers (uniform per run)
_source.client_sites_per_partner_month: estimate: an active agency adds a mascot to ~1 client site every 2 months

_source.units_median: estimate: a typical AppSumo-style deal for a new AI widget sells 50-500 codes
_source.partner_share: public benchmark style: marketplace keeps ~70% of marketplace-driven LTD sales
_source.payout_delay_weeks: estimate: marketplace payout after refund window (~60 days)
_source.active_share: estimate: share of LTD buyers who keep using it (they still cost LLM + support)

_source.hours_per_paid_customer_per_week: estimate: support email/chat, ~40 min/month per paying site
_source.hours_per_trial_per_week: estimate: onboarding emails, answering setup questions
_source.dfy_setup_hours: estimate: done-for-you install + content import + mascot tuning per new customer
_source.cs_cap_share: estimate: founders will not spend more than half their time on support
_source.onboarding_min: estimate: trial conversion multiplier with no onboarding help ... onboarding_max with full help
_source.shortfall_churn_mult: estimate: churn x(1 + this * share of support need not covered)
_source.dfy_conv_mult: estimate (board Offers lens): done-for-you removes setup effort
_source.guarantee_trust_boost: estimate: guarantee closes 40% of the 'no proof yet' gap
_source.guarantee_refund_rate: estimate: share of new customers who claim the 'lift or refund' guarantee
_source.early_tenure_churn_mult: public benchmark style: first 2 months churn ~1.3x steady-state
_source.capped_usage_churn_mult: estimate: customers hitting a hard quota with no overage are frustrated

_source.free_direct_share: estimate: with a free plan, ~60% of web signups pick free instead of the trial
_source.free_after_trial: estimate: share of non-converting trials that stay on the free plan
_source.free_upgrade_hazard: public benchmark style: freemium->paid ~2-5% over a year (0.6%/week while active)
_source.pro_compromise_starter: estimate: share of buyers needing Pro who settle for Starter when Pro is above their WTP
_source.overage_tolerance: estimate: buyers accept a total bill up to 1.3x their WTP before capping
_source.annual_uptake_per_10pct_discount: public benchmark style: ~20-30% of SMB SaaS customers pick annual at 15-20% discount
_source.resolution_rate: public benchmark style: share of conversations counted as 'resolutions' for per-resolution billing (Intercom Fin style)

_source.market_luck_sigma: estimate: correlated per-run demand shock (timing, macro, AI hype)
_source.segment_conv_sigma: estimate: per-run per-segment conversion uncertainty (we do not know these rates)
_source.wtp_sigma: estimate: per-run uncertainty on median WTP
_source.usage_sigma: estimate: per-run uncertainty on conversation volume

_source.proof_k: estimate: proof multiplier = (1-s) + s*(1-exp(-(happy + 2*reviews)/proof_k)); ~12 happy customers closes 63% of the gap
_source.competition_conv_effect: estimate: conversion x(1 - pressure*effect); Tidio/Crisp/Intercom Fin/Shopify Inbox are a click away

_source.search_share: estimate: share of relevant search demand ('AI chatbot for SaaS', 'mascot widget')
_source.visitor_to_signup: public benchmark style: SaaS landing pages convert 2-5% of visitors to signups, blog/comparison content 0.5-1.5%; blended content-led site ~1-2.5%
_source.trial_to_paid: estimate: trial->paid for a MATURE product with proof, among trialists whose WTP >= price; effective rate ends ~5-25% after WTP, proof, fit, actions and competition multipliers
_source.wtp_median: panel (partial, 20/100 answers: median 'expensive' ~49 across segments); indie hackers lowest - estimate
_source.style_appeal: board Product lens: cute style suits consumer/indie better than B2B - estimate
_source.need_actions: estimate: share of value that depends on on-site actions working
_source.churn_monthly: SPEC/public benchmark: small-SaaS churn 4-8%/month; indie hackers at the top
_source.reply_rate: SPEC: cold outreach reply 2-8% (uniform per run)
_source.cpc: public benchmark style: SaaS/AI keywords CPC 1.5-4 EUR
_source.reachable_pool: estimate: reachable buyers worldwide EN/FR (caps outreach)

_source.style_appeal: board Product lens: 'does a cocooning style work for B2B SaaS?' - estimate
_source.need_actions: board Offers lens: onboarding/activation is the outcome; needs in-app actions
_source.competition_pressure: board Monopoly lens: Intercom Fin, Pickaxe, Anam - estimate

_source.trial_to_paid: estimate; Shopify apps with trials typically 10-30%
_source.need_actions: board Offers/Product lens: find product, add to cart, start checkout
_source.competition_pressure: Tidio, Gorgias, Shopify Inbox (free), Rep AI - estimate

_source.wtp_median: estimate: per client site; board Offers lens: agencies resell, they don't buy

_source.trial_to_paid: board Offers lens: showcase sites have no measurable pain - estimate

_source.style_appeal: estimate: the cute house style fits kids/consumer apps best
_source.conv_per_month_median: estimate: consumer apps chat a lot - heavy LLM usage

_source.exploration_prob: SPEC: deterministic playbook + small random exploration
_source.revert_if_drop: estimate: revert a change that lowered survival by more than 4pp (above Monte Carlo noise)
_source.in_run: SPEC: e.g. shift hours from SEO to outreach if no trials by week 6 (here: fewer than min_trials OR MRR behind the linear pace to the M3 bar); estimate: part of the moved hours (up to launch_share) go to cheap one-shot launches (PH, directories) if none were done
_source.diagnosis: thresholds used to classify a death cause; benchmark trial->paid 20% (public SaaS benchmark mid-range)

_source.params: SPEC: +/-30% on each input assumption; '*' applies to every segment / list item; probabilities are capped at 0.99
